analysis.triageSummary: The alert indicates a brute force attack targeting the SSH service (sshd) on a local system. The source IP address 198.51.100.23 is attempting to authenticate using the username 'admin'. This is a classic credential stuffing or brute force attempt aimed at gaining unauthorized remote access. No evidence of successful authentication was provided in the telemetry, but the pattern is highly indicative of an active reconnaissance or exploitation phase.
analysis.probableRootCause: Exposed SSH service on a public-facing interface without adequate rate limiting or account lockout policies.
analysis.recommendedImmediateAction: Block the source IP (198.51.100.23) at the perimeter firewall and verify if any successful logins occurred for the 'admin' user during the timeframe.
